summary: First test run of Gas Pipe Sizing (UNI 7129) app. Backend: 18/18 pytest cases pass after fix. Fixed CRITICAL bug where MongoDB `_id` was leaking in POST/GET/LIST /api/calculations responses instead of `id` (would have broken frontend history navigation). Frontend: full happy path works end-to-end on mobile viewport 390x844 — gas segmented (Metano/GPL), material (Acciaio/Rame/Multistrato), length input, fittings chips (0/10/20/30), add-appliance modal with presets & custom, total-power updates, calculate, result diameter + Δp, save -> 'Salvato nello storico', history list, detail with URL id, delete confirm & return. GPL yields smaller/equal diameter than Metano for same input (verified). Deprecated package detected: `expo-router/unstable-native-tabs` → migrate to `expo-router/native-tabs`.

critical.issue: FIXED by tester: FastAPI was serializing Calculation model with alias (`_id`) instead of field name (`id`). Added response_model_by_alias=False to the three endpoints in /app/backend/server.py. Without the fix, FlatList keyExtractor and router.push(`/history/${item.id}`) in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/history.tsx would receive undefined and break navigation.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated import detected at runtime (console warning: '`expo-router/unstable-native-tabs` is deprecated. Use `expo-router/native-tabs` instead.'). Reference: likely in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx or /app/frontend/src/navigation.*

action_items: Migrate from `expo-router/unstable-native-tabs` to `expo-router/native-tabs` in the tabs layout to clear the deprecation warning.
(Optional) Consider renaming the Pydantic field to drop the `_id` alias and use a Field validator/serializer pattern instead of relying on response_model_by_alias=False, for cleaner API models.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: BaseDocument uses `Field(default=None, alias='_id')` with populate_by_name — FastAPI's default response serialization uses by_alias=True for Pydantic v2 aliased fields, causing `_id` leak. Fixed by adding response_model_by_alias=False on all 3 persistence endpoints.
server.py uses deprecated `@app.on_event('shutdown')` — consider migrating to FastAPI lifespan context managers.
history.tsx uses `keyExtractor={(i) => i.id}` which depends on the `id` field being present — now guaranteed by the fix.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (full happy path incl. GPL/Rame calc, save, history list, detail, delete)

seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data. All TEST_-prefixed calculations created during testing were cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) in frontend/.env. Public base URL: https://gas-pipe-sizing.preview.emergentagent.com. Mobile viewport 390x844. In the appliance modal, preset items may require scroll_into_view_if_needed() before click because the bottom-sheet ScrollView extends beyond viewport. Navigation between tabs can use text 'Storico'/'Calcola' or testID `tab-storico` (web may not expose tabBarButtonTestID as data-testid reliably).
rca_of_issue: Root cause of _id leak: In Pydantic v2, when a model field is declared with an alias (`alias='_id'`), FastAPI's default response serialization uses `by_alias=True` (confirmed by curl output). The to_mongo() helper excludes `id` and the DB insert produces an ObjectId; `calc.id = str(res.inserted_id)` populates the field, but the response goes out under the alias name. Mitigation: set `response_model_by_alias=False` on each endpoint using the Calculation response model. Verified fix: all tests pass and FE history navigation works end-to-end.
